summary: Blue Skies is the debut album by Diana DeGarmo, the runner-up of American Idol, released on RCA Records on December 7, 2004. The note states that the album debuted at number 52 and sold 47,000 copies in its first week, with cumulative sales of 168,000 copies.
one_line: Blue Skies is the 2004 debut album of American Idol runner-up Diana DeGarmo, released on RCA Records.
